auth.loginFooter: No account? Registration is by invite from the administrator.
auth.revoked: Session ended: it was used from another device. Sign in again and check your active sessions.

sessions.endOthers: Sign out on all other devices

errors.needServer: Requires a connection to the server
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {time}
errors.invalid_invite: The invite is invalid, expired or already used
errors.invalid_login: Login: 3 to 32 characters — Latin letters, digits, “_”, “.”, “-”

casing.fault: Machine spirit unresponsive. Reload the page.

profile.changeLoginHint: You will sign in with the new login. Sessions on other devices stay active.
profile.changePasswordHint: Changing the password ends all other sessions — other devices will need to sign in again.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions have been ended.

settings.screenTabsHint: On a large screen, sections are also switched with the keys on the left column of the casing — without on-screen tabs there is more room. Where the casing has no keys (narrow window, phone), tabs are always shown.

reference.placeholder: The content catalogue will live here: characteristics, skills, careers, rules. For now, reference entries open from a sheet.

invites.adminOnly: Only an administrator can create invites.
invites.showOnce: The code is shown only once — copy it now. The server keeps only its hash.
invites.copyFailed: Could not copy — select and copy it manually.

sheets.empty: No sheets yet. Create one or import a file.

importError.NOT_JSON: Can't read the file: it isn't JSON.
importError.NOT_CHARACTER: This isn't a Seydlitz Dataslate character file.
importError.FORMAT_TOO_NEW: The file comes from a newer version of the app — update it.
importError.UNKNOWN_SYSTEM: The sheet's game system isn't supported.
importError.SHEET_TOO_NEW: The sheet comes from a newer version of the app — update it.
importError.INVALID: The character file is damaged or malformed.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” on all devices? This can't be undone — export it first if needed.
sheet.saveFailed: Couldn't save: browser storage is unavailable or full. Export the sheet to a file.

sync.conflict: “{name}” was changed both here and on another device. Which version to keep?
sync.offline: No connection to the server — changes will be sent when it's back.
sync.error: Couldn't sync sheets, will retry later.
sync.renamed: Another player already has a sheet with this id — yours was saved as a copy.
